detector_count.note: det-01..20; det-20 appended 2026-05-16 as the audit-FP check. NOT '19 blocking + 1 advisory'.

field_contract.id: stable kebab/numeric key; deterministic detectors keep their taxonomy number as `det-NN`
field_contract.lane: deterministic | semantic — the orthogonal-detection axis (Pillar A). deterministic = grep/AST/tsc/git/import-graph/npm-audit, zero-FP, no LLM. semantic = LLM agent reasoning about behavior/intent.
field_contract.pillar: architecture | performance | security | maintainability | robustness | shortcut | wiring | completeness | framework | design
field_contract.base_confidence: 0.0-1.0 inverse-FP prior. deterministic ~0.6-1.0; single-pass semantic ~0.5; aggregated semantic (>=2 agreers) ~0.85.
field_contract.severity: P0 | P1 | P2 | P3 — enforcement layer / ratchet-tracking importance. NOTE: severity != verdict authority. A semantic P2 (sem-sec) is still advisory because semantic findings never flip a verdict.
field_contract.verdict_authority: reject | advisory. Derived: (lane==deterministic AND severity in {P0,P1,P2}) -> reject; else advisory. reject findings may flip a critic/gate verdict AND bypass the min-confidence gate (facts are not confidence-triaged). advisory findings only append to issues[] and are subject to min-confidence suppression.
field_contract.detection: {type, command}. type in {git, regex, tsc, ast, import-graph, counter, command, semantic}. command = executable detection (deterministic) OR checklist reference (semantic). THIS is the single source of executable detection logic; skills cite det-NN and run detection.command — no grep pattern lives in any skill/agent body.
field_contract.enforcement: where the check runs today (hook / critic section / skill phase)
field_contract.owner: the legacy skill that owns the canonical pattern (provenance)
field_contract.source: primary-source citation for the failure class
field_contract.notes: design notes incl. Opus-4.8-honesty sensitivity and aggregation requirement
field_contract.layer: design pillar only: 0 universal-slop (framework-independent, always on) | 1 token-discipline (normalized, adapter-resolved) | 2 adapter-conformance (fires only for the detected stack). See docs/integrations/impeccable/detector-rebuild.md.
field_contract.adapter: design pillar only: universal | tailwind | tailwind-md3 | vuetify | quasar. Selected by the stack signal from scripts/detect-stack.sh. universal = Layer 0 (all stacks); others gate Layer 1/2.
field_contract.exclude: (design regex rows) reference to a shared exclusion set (design.exclude): token-definition files + content/line guards applied before a finding is reported. Prevents within-stack FPs on @theme/config/theme token surfaces, comments, and SVG paint.
field_contract.perAdapter: (consolidated rules) per-adapter remediation message selected at firing by the detect-stack adapter; lets one normalized rule carry stack-specific guidance instead of N adapter-tagged duplicates.
field_contract.reconciliation: design pillar only (Layer 1): {relaxFor: [<adapter ids>], cite: <prescription>} or null. Rule suppressed when stack.primary in relaxFor; every relaxFor MUST carry a cite (the stack feature justifying it). e.g. bounce-easing relaxFor [tailwind-md3, quasar].

exclude.note: Adapter-gating prevents cross-stack FPs; these exclusions prevent within-stack FPs on token-definition surfaces (the v2.0.0 inflated-count failure mode).

confidence_gate.note_fp_cannot_raise: fp_verification_factor max is 1.0, so FP-verification can only PRESERVE or DROP a finding's confidence, never raise it. Only AGGREGATION (base 0.5 -> 0.85 on >=2 agreers) raises a semantic finding's confidence.
confidence_gate.reject_bypass: verdict_authority:reject findings BYPASS the min-confidence gate entirely. A ground-truth fact (e.g. det-06 env-fallback, base 0.75) is not confidence-triaged — if its deterministic detector fires (and FP-verify, where base<1.0, reproduces), it surfaces and may flip the verdict regardless of band. The min-confidence gate applies ONLY to advisory findings (semantic single-pass + advisory deterministic).
confidence_gate.review_default_min_confidence: high (>=0.8) — applies to ADVISORY findings only; precision-biased; suppress low-confidence advisories to avoid crying wolf. reject findings always surface (reject_bypass).
confidence_gate.audit_default_min_confidence: low (>=0.0) — report everything (incl. advisories), ranked by effective_confidence. recall-biased.
confidence_gate.downgrade_rule: a finding with fp_verification_factor=0.0 is DROPPED (disproven, not low-confidence). A deterministic finding that cannot be FP-verified retains base_confidence (mechanism is the verification). A SEMANTIC finding is capped at 'advisory' and can NEVER be a 'blocker' regardless of confidence (it has no reject authority); high aggregated confidence only raises its RANK, never its authority.
